text:
maria.p: Heads-up: SlimStream is GA on Hosted today. Designed for low-bandwidth and mobile clients. Internal docs: https://internal.redwood.company/docs/slimstream :tada:

alex.s: Is this a new streaming service or a mode?

maria.p: Mode on the existing gateway. Enable with stream_mode="slim" or SDK flag. Backwards-compatible but uses compact chunk frames and CDN-friendly chunking.

jordan.k: Any SDK changes?

maria.p: Minor bump to client SDK 2.4.0. It has helpers for reassembly and intermittent networks.

priya.r: Ops notes: default token window 4k, soft throttle at 120 rps/tenant. Fallback to standard streaming if slim capacity saturated. For guaranteed throughput request Dedicated or set reserved_concurrency.

alex.s: Migration example: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-slim","stream_mode":"slim","input":"summarize..."}'
```

maria.p: Note: chunk-level function-calls may batch differently. See function-calls section in the guide.

jordan.k: Billing impact?

maria.p: Billing still token-based. SlimStream reduces egress headers/heartbeat so typical egress savings ~20-35% for mobile patterns; unit price unchanged. Cost dashboard will show improvements after traffic ramps.

priya.r: Oncall checklist: add slim chunk control frame parser, watch metrics slim.stream.latency_p50 and slim.stream.chunk_retries. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.company/runbooks/slimstream-oncall

deploy-bot: release/slimstream-gw succeeded 026-04-12 build 2026.04.12.331. Canary at 100% us-west-2.

maria.p: Internal demo + Q&A Friday 09:30 PT. Please smoke test in sandbox: https://sandbox.redwood.ai/slim and post blockers in #devex.

alex.s: Will test this afternoon. :rocket:

jordan.k: I'll update the SDK changelog.

maria.p: Thanks team 026-04-12 0: SlimStream should help a lot for mobile latency-sensitive apps. :heart:
